_comment: Bar widgets allowed to break a rule of check_structure's bar widget template (docs/dev/bar/widget-style.md › The widget template). Each says why; an entry no longer needed fails the check.

Workspaces.reason: segmented cells: interactive cells with their own state, hover, click and run shape, window strips and a gliding indicator, not icon-plus-label parts; colours still come from the core through CellLook

CustomWidget.reason: external colour: a user script names the state colour (`stateColorName`), which the base resolves
